name: Draw & Guess
description: One person draws on their phone while everyone else guesses.

steps: Each turn, one player is the artist. They pick a word on their phone and draw it. Everyone sees it live on the TV.
Everyone else types guesses on their phone. No speaking the answer out loud, and no writing letters in the drawing.
Letters of the word are revealed as time runs out, so the clues get easier.
When the turn ends, the next player draws. Everyone gets a turn.
rules.scoring: Guess sooner for more points. Harder words are worth more. The artist earns points for every person who guesses it, plus a bonus if everyone does.
